title: Amendment-arrival underreaction: chain-position-conditioned event books on amendment vs first-vintage arrivals (limited attention to marginal disclosures; restatement-strain / disclosure-credibility lineage)
mechanism: WHO is the constrained actor: the attention-constrained marginal investor allocates scarce processing capacity by SALIENCE. The FIRST vintage of a periodic disclosure is a headline event: it is expected, dated, and covered. An AMENDMENT arrival — a second-or-later vintage of the same filer-period — is marginal news: it arrives off-cycle, carries no headline, and its information content is the DIFFERENCE against a prior vintage, so interpreting it requires memory of the earlier filing and a comparison step that salience-driven attention does not perform (Hirshleifer-Teoh 2003; Hong-Stein 1999 gradual diffusion). The disclosure-credibility/restatement-strain lineage adds the filer side: filers whose process produces amendments are initially discounted, and the corrected content is incorporated only as it survives scrutiny — a slow, attention-gated repricing. WHY the reaction is slow/attenuated: the amendment's marginal-disclosure form defeats salience-based attention allocation; the required comparison is costly; so the initial post-amendment reaction is systematically MORE incomplete than the first-vintage reaction, and the diffusion remainder over the following bars is correspondingly larger. WHAT the book does: it partitions evidenced filing arrivals by their chain position — the PIT rank of the arrival's stamp among its filer-period group's evidenced stamps — and trades the post-arrival path at AMENDMENT arrivals (position >= 2): after the first 5 STRICT_NEXT_BAR bars close, long (short) if the 5-bar sector-residual reaction is positive (negative), entered at the bar-6 close, exited at the bar-20 close, sector-neutralized with CASH absorbing imbalance — an event-time book keyed to the arrival instant, not a characteristic rank. The conditioning quantity (chain position) is PROCESS STRUCTURE counted from evidenced stamps only; no corrected value, revision direction or revision severity is read anywhere (the V10 direction/breadth usage forms are vetoed ancestry). WHEN it must fail: (i) if the sham-event placebo — the identical arithmetic at hash-seeded clear non-filing windows matched 1:1 to amendment arrivals in 20-bar length — reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x expectancy same sign, the amendment-arrival drift is generic continuation mechanics and the family DIES; (ii) the ORDERING FALSIFIER: the mechanism claims amendment arrivals are MORE underreacted than first-vintage arrivals; if the first-vintage neighbour matches or exceeds the anchor, the drift is generic-arrival drift (sibling H1's territory) and H2 is rejected as mechanism-mistitled EVEN IF its anchor passes the base gates; (iii) if pooled D2 Spearman |rho| > 0.20 vs any of the eleven veto entries, the proposal is INELIGIBLE before selection; (iv) if the anchor passes base gates but dies at stress x2 costs, the family is rejected at Stage-A honestly.
falsifiable_prediction: Directional and falsifiable, frozen before any PnL exists: (a) the anchor (amendment-arrival) book's long-short expectancy is > 0 per scored decision after base band costs, with position PF >= 1.10; (b) at least 2 of 3 folds positive, no populated fold PF < 0.8, max fold MDD <= 0.15; (c) SPY-excess positive overall and in >= 2 of 3 folds, and the declared sector-matched excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds; (d) THE MANDATORY SHAM FALSIFIER: the sham-event placebo matched to amendment arrivals does NOT reproduce the anchor — sham |expectancy| < 0.5x anchor expectancy OR opposite sign; if the sham reaches >= 0.5x same sign the family DIES — a reaction mechanism must beat its own placebo calendar; a control that outperforms a negative anchor in the anchor's direction also falsifies the family; (e) THE ORDERING FALSIFIER: anchor expectancy STRICTLY EXCEEDS the first-vintage neighbour's expectancy by more than 0.0 per decision — if the neighbour's expectancy >= the anchor's, the attention-to-marginal-disclosures mechanism is misattributed (the drift is generic-arrival drift) and H2 is REJECTED as mechanism-mistitled regardless of (a); (f) the neighbour's own expectancy is declared expected non-negative but strictly smaller — a negative neighbour with a positive anchor is the strongest form of the prediction and is not required; (g) anchor-vs-control position-vector Spearman rho < 0.95 measured pre-selection (declared expectation 0.0-0.3; rank identity forbidden); (h) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL ELEVEN veto entries measured at D2 pre-selection. If any of (a)-(h) fails, the family is rejected and amendment-arrival underreaction is declared untradable or unproven on this cohort at these costs; every failure mode is a successful research outcome.

exposure_definition: Per entity e and amendment arrival with stamp a and decision date t = its bar-6 close date: (0) chain_position(e,a) = 1-based stamp-time rank of a among e's same-filer-period-group evidenced stamps with stamp <= a (PIT); anchor events are chain_position >= 2, neighbour events chain_position = 1. (1) r_init(e,a) = prod(1 + r_e over STRICT bars 1-5) - 1 - [prod(1 + r_sector over the same 5 dates) - 1]; missing entity or ETF bar dates, or UNMAPPED sector tag, abstain-with-reason (counted). (2) exposure(e,t) = +1 if r_init > 0, -1 if r_init < 0, abstain if r_init == 0 exactly. (3) Book aggregation identical to sibling H1 (equal-weight, within-sector notional equalization, CASH absorbs). D2 RANKING CONTRACT: pooled Spearman rho of exposure(e,t) vs each of the ELEVEN veto entries on the SAME entity-decision pairs where the exposure is defined; pooled |rho| <= 0.20 required against all eleven. DECLARED PRIMARY RISKS: (a) 63-session momentum — the exposure is a short-horizon reaction sign, sharing return content with trend measures; measured, never argued; (b) the V10 revision-correction direction/breadth entry — the design contains NO revision value, but amendment arrivals correlate with revision activity mechanically, so if D2 measures |rho| > 0.20 vs that entry's exposure form, the proposal is INELIGIBLE before selection; the gate is MEASURED at D2 on the conditioning exposures (chain position partition + reaction sign), which is where novelty lives for this family.
